quote: I think you still do get enough sun exposure where it should be fine. I'm not too worried about it, to be honest with you, Chris.
stewart_read: Rep makes a personal technical judgment about solar suitability instead of using the escape hatch to the specialist.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive: rep didn't know the redirect line to use in the moment and improvised instead.
coaching_implication: Use the universal escape hatch: 'That's exactly what our specialist will map out with a shading study — let's get you on the calendar and they'll confirm.'

quote: And we don't see the sun till noontime in the winter.
stewart_read: This is a roof/home suitability objection that could stall the pitch; rep does not flip it or anchor it to bill pain, just reassures generically.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic: rep may be intentionally not engaging deeply since this is closer-tier material anyway.
coaching_implication: Tie the reassurance back to the bill: 'Even partial sun exposure plus a $150+ bill is exactly what the specialist will model out for you.'

quote: I should just let you talk to my husband. He has all more more of the details.
stewart_read: Janice defers the bill question entirely to Chris; rep accepts handoff smoothly without probing whether Janice has any awareness of typical bill range first.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic: getting the actual bill-payer on the line is more efficient than pressing Janice for a guess.
coaching_implication: This was the right move — but rep could note here for the handoff that Janice is not detail-owner, useful context for the closer.

stewart_read: Bill amount captured cleanly from Chris after Janice deferred.
coaching_implication: Capture succeeded but was never flipped emotionally — see anchor_use.

quote: I Solar power see, we've got a creek, in our backyard, and I was like, we could do hydro electro in the winter and solar in the summer.
stewart_read: Janice reveals unprompted enthusiasm and even a secondary energy idea (hydro), showing genuine curiosity beyond bill pain.
coaching_implication: Rep acknowledged generically ('Yeah.') and moved on — could have leaned into this excitement to build more rapport or flag it for the closer as a hook.

quote: the last thing to do is find a time for my energy specialist to give you guys a phone call and go through all the information about the the program, you know, show you the design, answer any questions you guys have.
stewart_read: No cross-sell or curiosity hook offered here; straightforward transition to booking, which is fine, but the earlier hydro-power comment was never used as a forward-pulling hook.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic: rep may be deliberately keeping scope tight and letting the specialist explore the hydro tangent.
coaching_implication: Low priority — mostly an opportunity cost, not a failure.
